title: Use the brand’s voice and tone consistently in displayed writing

statement.en: Use the brand’s voice and tone consistently in all displayed writing.
statement.ja: 表示するすべてのwritingでbrandのvoiceとtoneを一貫して使う。

conditions: Match word choice, punctuation, emoji, and sentence structure to the intended brand character.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Branding experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるBrandingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
